description: Generate database integration tests against a real database (Testcontainers): create/read/update/delete, transaction rollback and unique-constraint tests with your sample data. Prisma, TypeORM (TypeScript) or plain drivers (Python).

model.description: Prisma model / TypeORM entity name (default: singular PascalCase of tableName)

orm.description: prisma/typeorm → TypeScript + Jest; others → Python + pytest with the plain driver

sampleRow.description: A valid record without id, e.g. {"email": "a@b.co", "total_cents": 1200}

schemaSql.description: CREATE TABLE statement for the plain-driver (Python) tests

uniqueField.description: Column with a unique constraint (enables the duplicate test)

name: generate_db_integration_test
